title: 内容审核中的过滤位置与响应重写权衡
summary: 研究评估了内容审核中不同过滤位置（输入、输出、输入+输出）和响应重写的端到端效果。使用有用性和有害暴露两个客户结果指标，而非组件准确率。结果表明输出过滤在仅过滤场景下有用性最高，输入+输出有害暴露最低；重写可恢复大部分被阻断流量。探针路由相比LLM路由大幅降低延迟。
summary_en: Evaluates end-to-end trade-offs in content moderation filter placement (input, response, input+response) and response rewriting using usefulness and harmful exposure metrics. Response-only achieves highest filter-only usefulness, input+response lowest harmful exposure. Rewriting recovers most blocked traffic. Probe routing reduces latency vs LLM routing.
